name: Disable Remote Registry
description: Disables the Remote Registry service to reduce background activity and improve security by preventing remote access attempts.

description_i18n.en: Disables the Remote Registry service to reduce background activity and improve security by preventing remote access attempts.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert den Remote-Registry-Dienst, um Hintergrundaktivitäten zu reduzieren und die Sicherheit durch Verhinderung von Fernzugriffsversuchen zu verbessern.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le service de registre à distance pour réduire l'activité en arrière-plan et améliorer la sécurité en empêchant les tentatives d'accès distant.

warnings.title: Service state change
warnings.message: Related Windows services may stop or restart briefly while the action runs

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: The tweak changes the startup type of the RemoteRegistry Windows Service to Disabled and stops it if running This prevents remote registry connections from other computers on the network
